**Northbank Community Garden**
**North Gate Closed Saturday 18 April, 9 am to 2 pm**

The north gate will be shut for five hours on Saturday morning and early afternoon so that a leaking water pipe can be repaired. Everything else in the garden carries on, with two changes to the weekend's arrangements, set out below so you can find the part that affects you.

**Getting in**
Use the east entrance while the north gate is closed. The north gate reopens at 2 pm.

**Seed swap**
The seed swap moves to Sunday 19 April at 11 am. Same garden, same purpose, one day later. Tell anyone who might otherwise turn up on Saturday expecting to find it.

**Volunteering**
Volunteers are needed. Bring your own gloves. Tools are supplied, so there's no need to carry spades or forks from home. Resident Mina coordinates volunteers and can tell you where and when you're needed. Contact her at [Mina's phone number or email].

**In short**
North gate closed Saturday 18 April, 9 am to 2 pm. East entrance open. Seed swap on Sunday 19 April, 11 am. Volunteers bring gloves and speak to Mina.

Please pass this notice on to neighbours who use the garden but may not see the board.

The date checks out as Sunday, April 19th since the 18th was Saturday, so I'll keep that and draft using only the given facts with labelled lines to hit the word count.
